# Mandate & Guardian

> Trust Layer for AI Shopping Agents. The agent that spends is not the one that watches.

Mandate & Guardian is an independent auditor and safety layer for autonomous AI purchasing agents, built for the PayPal AI Hackathon 2026.

## Architecture and Core Endpoints

- [System Health](/api/health): Runtime status of catalog and AI reviewer
- [Audit Trail API](/api/records): Comprehensive audit records of all shopping proposals
- [Mandate Rules Engine](/api/mandates): Policy definition for caps, categories, and human confirmation thresholds
- [Documentation & Sandbox Guide](/docs/PAYPAL-TESTING.md): Sandbox verification and transaction flow
- [Source Code](https://github.com/JoelVelasqueZz/mandate-guardian): Repository documentation and verification tests
